student_fixed.motion_model: M1 calibration, unchanged (the round-2 refit stays rejected)

variants_in_priority_order.b0_w6_legacy: round-2 filter (regression: must equal the round-2 dev estimates of w6 on s910/s911 bit for bit)
variants_in_priority_order.a1_open: P0 open interval ends / off-screen sentinels in the likelihood
variants_in_priority_order.a2_open_scale: + slip scales redrawn on own load-state changes (motion_loaded.scale_std)
variants_in_priority_order.a4_open_scale_stuck_amcl: + augmented MCL, Nav2 recommended alphas (slow 0.001, fast 0.1), uniform free-space injection
variants_in_priority_order.a5_open_scale_stuck_amcl_local: + augmented MCL, injection capped at 10 %, 20 % uniform / 80 % Gaussian around the estimate

metrics.filter: vision (oracle reported alongside, never used for selection)
metrics.lost: pooled dev frames with position error > 0.30 m
metrics.false_triggers: injection frames while the error is < 0.10 m

selection_rule: Walk the fixes in the priority order above, starting from b0. A fix is adopted iff against the current base: L and P each rise by no more than 0.3 cm, AND (A or lost decreases, or L or P decreases by at least 0.3 cm).

a4 and a5 are two parameterisations of one fix (augmented MCL): the better of the two by (lost, then L, then A; differences within 0.2 cm or 1 % of frames count as ties, a tie goes to a4, the Nav2 structure) is the candidate for that step.
If further dev variants are needed (parameters of an adopted fix), each is added to dev_variants_v3.json with its reason BEFORE it runs, and the same rule applies.
The selected configuration is frozen in prereg_v3.json before any round-3 test episode is segmented, localized or scored.
gate: unchanged from round 2 (prereg.json): door_loaded pooled test lateral p99 <= 0.06 m AND position p90 <= 0.05 m AND yaw p90 <= 3.0 deg, >= 3 test episodes with >= 20 door_loaded frames. Not re-derived in this round (the round-2 FAIL stands).
